newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, tin, nickel down on sluggish demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, tin, nickel down on sluggish demand.

text.p: Prices of copper, tin and nickel fell on sluggish industrial demand while other metals held steady in dull trade, dealers said.

Ready copper lost 50 rupees to 11,850 rupees per quintal. Tin and nickel were subdued on improved supplies and a slide in global prices. Tin fell by 200 rupees to 35,700 rupees per quintal and nickel by 400 rupees to 38,800 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees per quintal and so was zinc at 6,325 rupees per quintal. Lead was unchanged at 5,000 rupees per quintal.
